agentDescription: Disposable unpublished LLM-only count-loop probe for Beam Agent Builder validation.
restrictions: Use only supplied synthetic task text. Do not call or reference external services.

nodes.name: Parse Synthetic Request
nodes.objective: Parse a synthetic batch or single-item validation request
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a deterministic test-request parser.

## Task:
Extract whether the supplied synthetic request is batch mode or single mode, and preserve its text.

## Context:
```
{request_text}
```

## Rules:
1. mode must be exactly batch or single.
2. Treat a request beginning with BATCH as batch; otherwise use single.
3. Output mode and source_text only.

nodes.name: Route Synthetic Request
nodes.objective: Route a parsed synthetic request to batch or single handling

edges.condition: the parsed request is batch mode or asks to process multiple work items
the parsed request is single mode or asks to process exactly one work item

nodes.name: Generate Synthetic Work Items
nodes.objective: Convert the batch request into a synthetic work item array
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a structured batch parser.

## Task:
Extract synthetic work items from the supplied batch request.

## Context:
```
{source_text}
```

## Rules:
1. Split semicolon-separated items.
2. Output work_items as an array of strings.
3. Output an empty array when no items are supplied.

nodes.name: Repeat Synthetic Validation Round
nodes.objective: Repeat the LLM validation marker exactly three times

nodes.name: Record Synthetic Validation Round
nodes.objective: Record an input-free marker for the current count-loop iteration
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a deterministic loop validation recorder.

## Task:
Emit one marker proving that the current count-loop body executed.

## Context:
No task input is required for this marker.

## Rules:
1. Output round_marker as exactly `count-loop body completed`.
2. Do not call or reference external services.
3. Do not request user input.

nodes.name: Compile Count Loop Results
nodes.objective: Compile the accumulated count-loop markers and synthetic items
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are an audit-summary compiler.

## Task:
Compile the loop markers and batch items into a concise synthetic report.

## Context:
```
{round_markers}
```

```
{work_items}
```

## Rules:
1. State how many loop markers are present.
2. Mention the supplied synthetic items.
3. Output final_report only.

nodes.name: Route Count Loop Report
nodes.objective: Route the compiled count-loop report to an explicit batch exit

edges.condition: the compiled report confirms the count-loop body completed three times
the compiled report does not confirm three completed count-loop body executions

nodes.name: Create Single Synthetic Result
nodes.objective: Create a synthetic result for a single-item request
nodes.prompt:
## Role:
You are a deterministic single-item validator.

## Task:
Produce one concise result for the supplied single-item request.

## Context:
```
{source_text}
```

## Rules:
1. State whether the item is explicitly READY.
2. Output final_report as one concise line.
3. Do not call external services.

nodes.name: Finish Completed Count Loop Validation
nodes.objective: Finish completed count-loop validation without side effects

nodes.name: Finish Incomplete Count Loop Validation
nodes.objective: Finish incomplete count-loop validation without side effects

nodes.name: Finish Single Validation
nodes.objective: Finish single validation without side effects
